subject: Follow-up: token inflation incident — remediation timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@hospiq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Incident: token inflation detected in your account — initial findings and next steps

Hi Alice,

Quick note to acknowledge an incident we detected in your account overnight that caused an overcount of generated tokens for a subset of requests between 02:10–02:34 UTC on 2028-03-29. The engineering team traced this to a race condition in the KV cache invalidation logic that duplicated final token accounting for long-running streaming sessions.

We’ve attached a preliminary token_usage_report.csv that isolates the affected request IDs and a short postmortem summary. Our immediate priorities are:
- Stop the duplication (already deployed a hotfix at 02:55 UTC)
- Recompute accurate token usage for the affected window
- Propose a one-time billing credit and provide a reconciliation artifact for your billing team

Marissa (AE) and Soojin (Ops) are on the thread to coordinate the credit and timeline. I expect a precise credit number and signed agreement for the one-time adjustment by EOD tomorrow.

You should not see any further duplication after the fix; we’ll follow up with the full postmortem and an internal action plan.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts forecasting and invoices. We will prioritize making this right.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
(attachment: token_usage_report.csv)
(attachment: redwood_postmortem_summary.pdf)

From: Alice Chen <alice@hospiq.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:41:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Incident: token inflation detected in your account — initial findings and next steps

Rafael,

Thanks for the quick heads up. This is worrying — our finance and ops teams will need a clear line item we can attach to the upcoming invoice. A few asks from us:
1) Please confirm the exact token delta (inflated minus true) and a suggested credit amount.
2) We need an attestable artifact (CSV + checksum) so our AP team can accept the correction.
3) If you can provide an ETA for when this will be reflected in our billing, that helps our SRE/finance sync.

We’re flexible on the format (credit invoice, one-time refund, or invoice adjustment) but will need a DocuSign agreement if a credit is applied. Please loop in finance.

— Alice
Alice Chen
VP Product, Hospiq Inc.
alice@hospiq.com
(attachment: internal-screenshot.png)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:05:30 -0400
Subject: RE: Incident: token inflation detected in your account — action items for credit and reconciliation

Team,

Summary of what Alice needs and proposed internal owners:
- Exact token delta & reconciliation CSV (Ops, Soojin) — deliverable: token_delta_summary.csv, ETA: 2028-03-29 17:00 EDT
- Proposed credit amount and accounting approach (Finance, Sean) — deliverable: draft one-time credit invoice, ETA: 2028-03-29 18:00 EDT
- Formal credit agreement for customer signature (Rafael + Legal template) — Rafael, please push DocuSign link once credit amount is confirmed.

I suggest we offer a conservative credit equal to the inflated token count * list price, then round up 5% as a goodwill adjustment. If Alice prefers an alternative (refund or invoice adjustment), we will accommodate.

Soojin — can you confirm the root cause summary in the attached postmortem and the set of request IDs included? I will own the customer communication once we have numbers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@hospiq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Formal remediation & credit agreement — Hospiq token inflation incident (MAR-29)

Hi Alice,

Thank you for your patience. Attached is the reconciliation artifact and our proposed credit: we computed 1,256,730 inflated tokens over the affected window. Using your committed list price, that yields a calculated credit of $12,567.30; we have rounded this to a one-time credit of $13,200 to expedite reconciliation (includes a 5% goodwill uplift).

Attachments: token_delta_summary.csv (with CRC32 checksum), redwood_postmortem_summary.pdf, one-time-credit-agreement.docx

To proceed:
1) Please review the CSV and confirm receipt.
2) If acceptable, sign the one-time credit agreement via this DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/confirm/ABC123 — signing will automatically apply the credit to your next invoice.
3) If instead you prefer a direct refund, reply and we’ll route to finance for ACH.

Timeline:
- Reconciliation artifact delivered: 2028-03-30 11:20 EDT
- DocuSign sent: 2028-03-30 11:21 EDT
- Expected credit application on next invoice cycle if signed: 2028-04-05

Operational notes: the hotfix removed the duplication and we validated no additional affected sessions after 02:55 UTC. We will follow up with a full engineering postmortem and a schedule of code changes to prevent recurrence.

Apologies again for the disruption — we appreciate your partnership and will make the reconciliation as frictionless as possible.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
(attachment: token_delta_summary.csv)
(attachment: one-time-credit-agreement.docx)
